parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: Unique customer-scoped inventory withdrawal command key.

parameters.name: Webhook-Timestamp
parameters.description: Unix timestamp included in the Arc Pay signed payload.

parameters.name: Webhook-Signature
parameters.description: Arc Pay HMAC signature in `t=<unix>,v1=<hex>` format. Fake mode also accepts X-Arc-Pay-Signature.

parameters.name: Webhook-Id
parameters.description: Provider webhook idempotency id. In fake mode this may also be present in the JSON payload.
